docs.title: Folioman Client
docs.text:
An embedded, typed Python portfolio engine and CLI for Indian mutual funds and equities.

The folioman-client library provides a high-performance, asynchronous financial engine that can be embedded directly into wealth management backends, financial analysis scripts, notebooks, or desktop applications. It also ships with a command-line interface (folioman) for statement ingestion and portfolio maintenance.

Self-Contained & Embedded

Starting with v0.2.0, folioman-client is completely serverless. It does not require a running external Folioman web server, Docker daemon, or Django setup. It uses an embedded SQLite database by default, with pluggable support for PostgreSQL and MySQL.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Embedded Pluggable Storage: Zero-configuration SQLite out of the box with automatic WAL mode and concurrency locks. Seamlessly connect to PostgreSQL or MySQL using standard connection URLs (postgresql+psycopg://...).
  • Unified Single-Database Architecture: User portfolios, transaction ledgers, historical NAV points, and the 100,000-row national ISIN reference dictionary are stored entirely within the configured database.
  • Statement Ingestion: Ingest CAMS/KFintech mutual fund statements and NSDL/CDSL eCAS demat statements directly, with idempotent SHA-256 deduplication and automatic partial-block convergence.
  • Real-Time & Historical Feeds: Multi-source quote fetching across mfapi.in, AMFI bulk text dumps, Yahoo Finance, and NSE Bhavcopy archives with automated historical gap filling.
  • Accurate Financial Math: First-In-First-Out (FIFO) lot accounting, Section 48 brokerage inclusions, and high-precision Newton-Raphson / bisection XIRR root-finding.
  • Indian Capital Gains Tax (Schedule 112A): Full LTCG/STCG reporting, Section 112A grandfathering (31-Jan-2018 FMV lookup), and Budget 2024 regime cutoffs (23-Jul-2024).
  • Non-Destructive Corporate Actions: Dynamic event replay of stock splits, bonuses, mergers, and demergers on read without corrupting original tradebook contract notes.
  • Full CLI Suite: Terminal command suite (folioman) for statement imports, reference database updates, NAV refreshes, and valuations.

docs.title: Minimal Example
docs.text:
import asyncio
from folioman_client import FoliomanClient


async def main() -> None:
    # Zero-setup: defaults to local SQLite; or pass PostgreSQL URL
    async with FoliomanClient() as client:
        # Ingest statement
        job = await client.imports.cas_pdf("cas_statement.pdf", password="MY_PAN_NUMBER")
        print(f"Imported {job.result.get('transactions_created', 0)} transactions.")

        # Sync latest NAVs & prices
        await client.navs.refresh()

        # Query portfolio summary
        summary = await client.portfolio.get(investor_id=1)
        print(f"Total Value: INR {summary.total_inr:,.2f}")
        print(f"XIRR: {summary.xirr * 100:.2f}%" if summary.xirr else "XIRR: N/A")

        # Inspect priced holdings
        holdings = await client.holdings.list(investor_id=1)
        for h in holdings:
            print(f"- {h.name}: {h.units} units | Value: INR {h.value_inr:,.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

class JWTAuthManager:
    """Manages JWT authentication state, token storage, and refresh lifecycle.

    Keeps tokens private so they are never leaked outside the client.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        username: str,
        password: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize JWTAuthManager with API credentials.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the Folioman server.
            username: Username for authentication.
            password: Password for authentication.
        """
        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._username = username
        self._password = password
        self._access_token: str | None = None
        self._refresh_token: str | None = None
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    @property
    def has_tokens(self) -> bool:
        """True if the manager currently holds an access or refresh token."""
        return self._access_token is not None or self._refresh_token is not None

    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear cached access and refresh tokens."""
        self._access_token = None
        self._refresh_token = None

    async def get_valid_token(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Return a valid access token, proactively refreshing or authenticating if needed.

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance to execute requests.

        Returns:
            A valid JWT access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication or refresh fails.
        """
        # Fast path outside the lock if the current access token is fresh
        if self._access_token and not _is_expired(self._access_token):
            return self._access_token

        async with self._lock:
            # Re-check under lock in case another coroutine refreshed it
            if self._access_token and not _is_expired(self._access_token):
                return self._access_token

            # Try refresh if we have a refresh token
            if self._refresh_token:
                try:
                    return await self._refresh_access_token(client)
                except Exception:
                    # If refresh fails, fall back to initial authentication
                    pass

            # Otherwise, authenticate from credentials
            return await self._authenticate(client)

    async def force_refresh(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Force a refresh or re-authentication after receiving a 401.

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance to execute requests.

        Returns:
            A new valid JWT access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If renewal or re-authentication fails.
        """
        async with self._lock:
            if self._refresh_token:
                try:
                    return await self._refresh_access_token(client)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            return await self._authenticate(client)

    async def _authenticate(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Authenticate with username and password (/api/auth/token/pair).

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance.

        Returns:
            A newly acquired access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails or response is invalid.
        """
        url = f"{self._base_url}/api/auth/token/pair"
        payload = {"username": self._username, "password": self._password}

        try:
            response = await client.post(url, json=payload)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Network error during authentication: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if response.status_code == 401:
            raise FoliomanAuthError("Invalid username or password.")
        if not response.is_success:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Authentication failed with status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()
        access = data.get("access")
        refresh = data.get("refresh")
        if not access or not refresh:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                "Malformed authentication response: missing tokens."
            )

        self._access_token = access
        self._refresh_token = refresh
        return access

    async def _refresh_access_token(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Mint a fresh access token from the refresh token (/api/auth/token/refresh).

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance.

        Returns:
            A refreshed access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If refresh token is expired, invalid, or missing.
        """
        if not self._refresh_token:
            raise FoliomanAuthError("No refresh token available.")

        url = f"{self._base_url}/api/auth/token/refresh"
        payload = {"refresh": self._refresh_token}

        try:
            response = await client.post(url, json=payload)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Network error during token refresh: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if response.status_code == 401:
            self.clear()
            raise FoliomanAuthError("Refresh token expired or invalid.")
        if not response.is_success:
            self.clear()
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Token refresh failed with status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()
        access = data.get("access")
        if not access:
            self.clear()
            raise FoliomanAuthError("Malformed refresh response: missing access token.")

        self._access_token = access
        return access

class CapitalGainsResource(_BaseResource):
    """Endpoints for realised capital gains reporting."""

    async def list(
        self,
        investor_id: int,
        *,
        include_unreconciled: bool = False,
    ) -> list[CapitalGainsFyPoint]:
        """List realised STCG/LTCG across every financial year with disposals.

        Args:
            investor_id: The ID of the investor.
            include_unreconciled: Whether to include unreconciled transactions.

        Returns:
            List of CapitalGainsFyPoint models summarizing capital gains by financial year.

        Raises:
            FoliomanNotFoundError: If the investor does not exist.
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails.
            FoliomanAPIError: If the server returns an error response.
        """
        params = {"include_unreconciled": str(include_unreconciled).lower()}
        data = await self._client.request(
            "GET",
            f"/investors/{investor_id}/reports/capital-gains-by-fy",
            params=params,
        )
        return [CapitalGainsFyPoint.model_validate(item) for item in data]

    async def get(
        self,
        investor_id: int,
        *,
        fy: str,
        include_unreconciled: bool = False,
    ) -> CapitalGainsReport:
        """Get realised capital gains report for a specific financial year.

        Args:
            investor_id: The ID of the investor.
            fy: Financial year string, e.g. "2024-25".
            include_unreconciled: Whether to include unreconciled transactions.

        Returns:
            CapitalGainsReport model with detailed lot-level gains.

        Raises:
            FoliomanNotFoundError: If the investor does not exist.
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails.
            FoliomanAPIError: If the server returns an error response.
        """
        params = {
            "fy": fy,
            "include_unreconciled": str(include_unreconciled).lower(),
        }
        data = await self._client.request(
            "GET",
            f"/investors/{investor_id}/exports/capital-gains",
            params=params,
        )
        return CapitalGainsReport.model_validate(data)

class FoliomanClient:
    """Asynchronous client for interacting with the Folioman API.

    Handles authentication, token refresh, and request execution.

    Example:
        ```python
        import asyncio
        from folioman_client import FoliomanClient

        async def main() -> None:
            async with FoliomanClient() as client:
                investor = await client.investors.get(1)
                summary = await client.portfolio.get(1)
                print(investor.name, summary.total_inr)

        asyncio.run(main())
        ```
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str | None = None,
        username: str | None = None,
        password: str | None = None,
        timeout: float = 30.0,
        http_client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize FoliomanClient.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the Folioman REST API. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
            username: Username for API authentication. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
            password: Password for API authentication. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.0.
            http_client: Optional custom httpx.AsyncClient instance for custom transport/pooling.
        """
        self.base_url = (base_url or default_settings.base_url).rstrip("/")
        self.username = username if username is not None else default_settings.username
        self.password = password if password is not None else default_settings.password
        self.timeout = timeout

        self._auth = JWTAuthManager(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            username=self.username,
            password=self.password,
        )

        self._owns_http_client = http_client is None
        self._http_client = http_client or httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            timeout=self.timeout,
        )

        # Resource sub-clients
        self.investors = InvestorsResource(self)
        self.portfolio = PortfolioResource(self)
        self.holdings = HoldingsResource(self)
        self.transactions = TransactionsResource(self)
        self.valuations = ValuationsResource(self)
        self.capital_gains = CapitalGainsResource(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls, settings: FoliomanSettings) -> FoliomanClient:
        """Create a client instance from a FoliomanSettings object.

        Args:
            settings: FoliomanSettings configuration object.

        Returns:
            A configured FoliomanClient instance.
        """
        return cls(
            base_url=settings.base_url,
            username=settings.username,
            password=settings.password,
            timeout=settings.timeout,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> FoliomanClient:
        """Create a client instance using environment variables.

        Returns:
            A configured FoliomanClient instance using environment defaults.
        """
        return cls.from_settings(FoliomanSettings())

    async def __aenter__(self) -> FoliomanClient:
        """Enter the async context manager.

        Returns:
            The FoliomanClient instance.
        """
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any) -> None:
        """Exit the async context manager and close HTTP connections."""
        await self.close()

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the underlying HTTP transport if owned by this client."""
        if self._owns_http_client:
            await self._http_client.aclose()

    def _normalize_path(self, path: str) -> str:
        """Ensure path starts with /api prefix as required by Folioman API.

        Args:
            path: Relative API path string.

        Returns:
            Normalized path starting with '/api/'.
        """
        path = path.strip()
        if not path.startswith("/"):
            path = f"/{path}"
        if not path.startswith("/api/"):
            path = f"/api{path}"
        return path

    async def request(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        *,
        params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        json: Any | None = None,
        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Any:
        """Execute an authenticated HTTP request with automatic token refresh and 401 retry.

        Args:
            method: HTTP method ("GET", "POST", etc.)
            path: Relative API path (e.g. "/investors/1")
            params: Optional query parameters.
            json: Optional JSON request payload.
            headers: Optional extra headers.
            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments passed to httpx.AsyncClient.request.

        Returns:
            Parsed JSON response, or None if status code is 204 or body is empty.

        Raises:
            FoliomanNotFoundError: If response is 404.
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails or refresh is rejected.
            FoliomanAPIError: If server responds with other 4xx or 5xx status codes.
        """
        normalized_path = self._normalize_path(path)
        req_headers = dict(headers or {})

        # Obtain valid Bearer token
        token = await self._auth.get_valid_token(self._http_client)
        req_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"

        response = await self._http_client.request(
            method=method,
            url=normalized_path,
            params=params,
            json=json,
            headers=req_headers,
            **kwargs,
        )

        # Reactive refresh if 401 Unauthorized occurs
        if response.status_code == 401:
            new_token = await self._auth.force_refresh(self._http_client)
            req_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {new_token}"
            response = await self._http_client.request(
                method=method,
                url=normalized_path,
                params=params,
                json=json,
                headers=req_headers,
                **kwargs,
            )

        return self._handle_response(response, normalized_path)

    def _handle_response(self, response: httpx.Response, path: str) -> Any:
        """Process HTTP response, translating errors to Folioman client exceptions.

        Args:
            response: httpx.Response object.

            FoliomanNotFoundError: If response status is 404.
            FoliomanAuthError: If response status is 401.
            FoliomanAPIError: If response status is not successful or parsing fails.
        """

            raise FoliomanNotFoundError(f"Resource not found at {path}")

        if response.status_code == 401:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(f"Authentication failed for {path} (HTTP 401)")

        if not response.is_success:

            try:

            raise FoliomanAPIError(

                status_code=response.status_code,
                response_data=detail,
            )

        if response.status_code == 204 or not response.content:
            return None

        try:
            return response.json()
        except Exception as exc:
            raise FoliomanAPIError(
                message=f"Failed to parse JSON response from {path}: {exc}",
                status_code=response.status_code,
                response_data=response.text,
            ) from exc

def __init__(
    self,
    base_url: str | None = None,
    username: str | None = None,
    password: str | None = None,
    timeout: float = 30.0,
    http_client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Initialize FoliomanClient.

    Args:
        base_url: Base URL of the Folioman REST API. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
        username: Username for API authentication. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
        password: Password for API authentication. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
        timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.0.
        http_client: Optional custom httpx.AsyncClient instance for custom transport/pooling.
    """
    self.base_url = (base_url or default_settings.base_url).rstrip("/")
    self.username = username if username is not None else default_settings.username
    self.password = password if password is not None else default_settings.password
    self.timeout = timeout

    self._auth = JWTAuthManager(

        username=self.username,
        password=self.password,

    self._owns_http_client = http_client is None
    self._http_client = http_client or httpx.AsyncClient(
        base_url=self.base_url,
        timeout=self.timeout,

    self.investors = InvestorsResource(self)
    self.portfolio = PortfolioResource(self)

async def request(
    self,
    method: str,
    path: str,
    *,
    params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    json: Any | None = None,
    headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> Any:
    """Execute an authenticated HTTP request with automatic token refresh and 401 retry.

    Args:
        method: HTTP method ("GET", "POST", etc.)
        path: Relative API path (e.g. "/investors/1")
        params: Optional query parameters.
        json: Optional JSON request payload.
        headers: Optional extra headers.
        **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments passed to httpx.AsyncClient.request.

    Returns:
        Parsed JSON response, or None if status code is 204 or body is empty.

    Raises:
        FoliomanNotFoundError: If response is 404.
        FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails or refresh is rejected.
        FoliomanAPIError: If server responds with other 4xx or 5xx status codes.
    """
    normalized_path = self._normalize_path(path)
    req_headers = dict(headers or {})

    # Obtain valid Bearer token
    token = await self._auth.get_valid_token(self._http_client)
    req_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"

    response = await self._http_client.request(
        method=method,
        url=normalized_path,
        params=params,
        json=json,
        headers=req_headers,
        **kwargs,
    )

    # Reactive refresh if 401 Unauthorized occurs
    if response.status_code == 401:
        new_token = await self._auth.force_refresh(self._http_client)
        req_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {new_token}"
        response = await self._http_client.request(
            method=method,
            url=normalized_path,
            params=params,
            json=json,
            headers=req_headers,
            **kwargs,
        )

    return self._handle_response(response, normalized_path)

class InvestorsResource(_BaseResource):

    async def list(
        self,
        *,
        family_id: int | None = None,
        unaffiliated: bool = False,
    ) -> list[Investor]:
        """List investors accessible to the authenticated advisor.

        params: dict[str, Any] = {}

        if unaffiliated:

        data = await self._client.request("GET", "/investors/", params=params)
        return [Investor.model_validate(item) for item in data]

    async def get(self, investor_id: int) -> InvestorDetail:
        """Get investor details including masked PAN.

        Args:

        Returns:

        Raises:
            FoliomanNotFoundError: If the investor ID does not exist.
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails.
            FoliomanAPIError: If the server returns an error response.
        """

        return InvestorDetail.model_validate(data)

class FoliomanClient:
    """Asynchronous client for interacting with the Folioman API.

    Handles authentication, token refresh, and request execution.

    Example:
        ```python
        import asyncio
        from folioman_client import FoliomanClient

        async def main() -> None:
            async with FoliomanClient() as client:
                investor = await client.investors.get(1)
                summary = await client.portfolio.get(1)
                print(investor.name, summary.total_inr)

        asyncio.run(main())
        ```
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str | None = None,
        username: str | None = None,
        password: str | None = None,
        timeout: float = 30.0,
        http_client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize FoliomanClient.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the Folioman REST API. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
            username: Username for API authentication. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
            password: Password for API authentication. If None, loaded from settings/environment.
            timeout: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 30.0.
            http_client: Optional custom httpx.AsyncClient instance for custom transport/pooling.
        """
        self.base_url = (base_url or default_settings.base_url).rstrip("/")
        self.username = username if username is not None else default_settings.username
        self.password = password if password is not None else default_settings.password
        self.timeout = timeout

        self._auth = JWTAuthManager(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            username=self.username,
            password=self.password,
        )

        self._owns_http_client = http_client is None
        self._http_client = http_client or httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            timeout=self.timeout,
        )

        # Resource sub-clients
        self.investors = InvestorsResource(self)
        self.portfolio = PortfolioResource(self)
        self.holdings = HoldingsResource(self)
        self.transactions = TransactionsResource(self)
        self.valuations = ValuationsResource(self)
        self.capital_gains = CapitalGainsResource(self)

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls, settings: FoliomanSettings) -> FoliomanClient:
        """Create a client instance from a FoliomanSettings object.

        Args:
            settings: FoliomanSettings configuration object.

        Returns:
            A configured FoliomanClient instance.
        """
        return cls(
            base_url=settings.base_url,
            username=settings.username,
            password=settings.password,
            timeout=settings.timeout,
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> FoliomanClient:
        """Create a client instance using environment variables.

        Returns:
            A configured FoliomanClient instance using environment defaults.
        """
        return cls.from_settings(FoliomanSettings())

    async def __aenter__(self) -> FoliomanClient:
        """Enter the async context manager.

        Returns:
            The FoliomanClient instance.
        """
        return self

    async def __aexit__(self, exc_type: Any, exc_val: Any, exc_tb: Any) -> None:
        """Exit the async context manager and close HTTP connections."""
        await self.close()

    async def close(self) -> None:
        """Close the underlying HTTP transport if owned by this client."""
        if self._owns_http_client:
            await self._http_client.aclose()

    def _normalize_path(self, path: str) -> str:
        """Ensure path starts with /api prefix as required by Folioman API.

        Args:
            path: Relative API path string.

        Returns:
            Normalized path starting with '/api/'.
        """
        path = path.strip()
        if not path.startswith("/"):
            path = f"/{path}"
        if not path.startswith("/api/"):
            path = f"/api{path}"
        return path

    async def request(
        self,
        method: str,
        path: str,
        *,
        params: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        json: Any | None = None,
        headers: dict[str, str] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> Any:
        """Execute an authenticated HTTP request with automatic token refresh and 401 retry.

        Args:
            method: HTTP method ("GET", "POST", etc.)
            path: Relative API path (e.g. "/investors/1")
            params: Optional query parameters.
            json: Optional JSON request payload.
            headers: Optional extra headers.
            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments passed to httpx.AsyncClient.request.

        Returns:
            Parsed JSON response, or None if status code is 204 or body is empty.

        Raises:
            FoliomanNotFoundError: If response is 404.
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails or refresh is rejected.
            FoliomanAPIError: If server responds with other 4xx or 5xx status codes.
        """
        normalized_path = self._normalize_path(path)
        req_headers = dict(headers or {})

        # Obtain valid Bearer token
        token = await self._auth.get_valid_token(self._http_client)
        req_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"

        response = await self._http_client.request(
            method=method,
            url=normalized_path,
            params=params,
            json=json,
            headers=req_headers,
            **kwargs,
        )

        # Reactive refresh if 401 Unauthorized occurs
        if response.status_code == 401:
            new_token = await self._auth.force_refresh(self._http_client)
            req_headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {new_token}"
            response = await self._http_client.request(
                method=method,
                url=normalized_path,
                params=params,
                json=json,
                headers=req_headers,
                **kwargs,
            )

        return self._handle_response(response, normalized_path)

    def _handle_response(self, response: httpx.Response, path: str) -> Any:
        """Process HTTP response, translating errors to Folioman client exceptions.

        Args:
            response: httpx.Response object.
            path: Normalized path requested.

        Returns:
            Parsed response JSON or None.

        Raises:
            FoliomanNotFoundError: If response status is 404.
            FoliomanAuthError: If response status is 401.
            FoliomanAPIError: If response status is not successful or parsing fails.
        """
        if response.status_code == 404:
            raise FoliomanNotFoundError(f"Resource not found at {path}")

        if response.status_code == 401:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(f"Authentication failed for {path} (HTTP 401)")

        if not response.is_success:
            detail: Any = None
            try:
                data = response.json()
                detail = data.get("detail", data)
            except Exception:
                detail = response.text
            raise FoliomanAPIError(
                message=f"Folioman API error on {response.request.method} {path}: {detail}",
                status_code=response.status_code,
                response_data=detail,
            )

        if response.status_code == 204 or not response.content:
            return None

        try:
            return response.json()
        except Exception as exc:
            raise FoliomanAPIError(
                message=f"Failed to parse JSON response from {path}: {exc}",
                status_code=response.status_code,
                response_data=response.text,
            ) from exc

class JWTAuthManager:
    """Manages JWT authentication state, token storage, and refresh lifecycle.

    Keeps tokens private so they are never leaked outside the client.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        username: str,
        password: str,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize JWTAuthManager with API credentials.

        Args:
            base_url: Base URL of the Folioman server.
            username: Username for authentication.
            password: Password for authentication.
        """
        self._base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self._username = username
        self._password = password
        self._access_token: str | None = None
        self._refresh_token: str | None = None
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    @property
    def has_tokens(self) -> bool:
        """True if the manager currently holds an access or refresh token."""
        return self._access_token is not None or self._refresh_token is not None

    def clear(self) -> None:
        """Clear cached access and refresh tokens."""
        self._access_token = None
        self._refresh_token = None

    async def get_valid_token(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Return a valid access token, proactively refreshing or authenticating if needed.

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance to execute requests.

        Returns:
            A valid JWT access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication or refresh fails.
        """
        # Fast path outside the lock if the current access token is fresh
        if self._access_token and not _is_expired(self._access_token):
            return self._access_token

        async with self._lock:
            # Re-check under lock in case another coroutine refreshed it
            if self._access_token and not _is_expired(self._access_token):
                return self._access_token

            # Try refresh if we have a refresh token
            if self._refresh_token:
                try:
                    return await self._refresh_access_token(client)
                except Exception:
                    # If refresh fails, fall back to initial authentication
                    pass

            # Otherwise, authenticate from credentials
            return await self._authenticate(client)

    async def force_refresh(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Force a refresh or re-authentication after receiving a 401.

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance to execute requests.

        Returns:
            A new valid JWT access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If renewal or re-authentication fails.
        """
        async with self._lock:
            if self._refresh_token:
                try:
                    return await self._refresh_access_token(client)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            return await self._authenticate(client)

    async def _authenticate(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Authenticate with username and password (/api/auth/token/pair).

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance.

        Returns:
            A newly acquired access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If authentication fails or response is invalid.
        """
        url = f"{self._base_url}/api/auth/token/pair"
        payload = {"username": self._username, "password": self._password}

        try:
            response = await client.post(url, json=payload)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Network error during authentication: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if response.status_code == 401:
            raise FoliomanAuthError("Invalid username or password.")
        if not response.is_success:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Authentication failed with status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()
        access = data.get("access")
        refresh = data.get("refresh")
        if not access or not refresh:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                "Malformed authentication response: missing tokens."
            )

        self._access_token = access
        self._refresh_token = refresh
        return access

    async def _refresh_access_token(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
        """Mint a fresh access token from the refresh token (/api/auth/token/refresh).

        Args:
            client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance.

        Returns:
            A refreshed access token string.

        Raises:
            FoliomanAuthError: If refresh token is expired, invalid, or missing.
        """
        if not self._refresh_token:
            raise FoliomanAuthError("No refresh token available.")

        url = f"{self._base_url}/api/auth/token/refresh"
        payload = {"refresh": self._refresh_token}

        try:
            response = await client.post(url, json=payload)
        except Exception as exc:
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Network error during token refresh: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if response.status_code == 401:
            self.clear()
            raise FoliomanAuthError("Refresh token expired or invalid.")
        if not response.is_success:
            self.clear()
            raise FoliomanAuthError(
                f"Token refresh failed with status {response.status_code}: {response.text}"
            )

        data = response.json()
        access = data.get("access")
        if not access:
            self.clear()
            raise FoliomanAuthError("Malformed refresh response: missing access token.")

        self._access_token = access
        return access

async def get_valid_token(self, client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> str:
    """Return a valid access token, proactively refreshing or authenticating if needed.

    Args:
        client: The httpx AsyncClient transport instance to execute requests.

    Returns:
        A valid JWT access token string.

    Raises:
        FoliomanAuthError: If authentication or refresh fails.
    """
    # Fast path outside the lock if the current access token is fresh
    if self._access_token and not _is_expired(self._access_token):
        return self._access_token

    async with self._lock:
        # Re-check under lock in case another coroutine refreshed it
        if self._access_token and not _is_expired(self._access_token):
            return self._access_token

        # Try refresh if we have a refresh token
        if self._refresh_token:
            try:
                return await self._refresh_access_token(client)
            except Exception:
                # If refresh fails, fall back to initial authentication
                pass

        # Otherwise, authenticate from credentials
        return await self._authenticate(client)

class FoliomanAPIError(FoliomanError):
    """Raised when the Folioman API returns an error response (HTTP 4xx/5xx).

    Attributes:
        status_code: The HTTP status code returned by the server.
        response_data: Parsed response payload or raw error details, if available.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        status_code: int,
        response_data: Any | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        """Initialize FoliomanAPIError with message, status code, and optional payload.

        Args:
            message: Human-readable description of the error.
            status_code: HTTP response status code (e.g., 400, 500).
            response_data: Deserialized JSON payload or raw text error from the server.
        """
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.response_data = response_data

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        base = super().__str__()
        if self.response_data:
            return f"[{self.status_code}] {base} - {self.response_data}"
        return f"[{self.status_code}] {base}"

docs.title: CLI Reference
docs.text: folioman-client includes a comprehensive command-line interface folioman. It allows you to ingest statements, sync prices, manage the reference ISIN dictionary, and run portfolio reconciliations directly from your terminal.

docs.title: Global Options
docs.text:
All folioman commands support the following global options:

  • --db <URL>: SQLAlchemy database URL (e.g. postgresql+psycopg://user:pass@localhost/portfolio). If omitted, uses the FOLIOMAN_DATABASE_URL environment variable or defaults to SQLite (~/.folioman/folioman.db).
  • --data-dir <PATH>: Custom directory for local files and logs. Overrides FOLIOMAN_DATA_DIR.
  • -v, --verbose: Enable debug logging and verbose SQL output.
  • --help: Display help and usage information.

docs.title: 1. folioman isin
docs.text:
Manages the national ISIN, mutual fund scheme, and grandfathering reference catalog.

# Seed reference dictionary into the database from the bundled offline dataset
folioman isin seed

# Check remote repository (casparser.atomcoder.com) and download updates
folioman isin update

# Inspect current ISIN database version and last updated timestamp
folioman isin status

docs.title: 2. folioman import
docs.text: Ingests statement files into the selected database.

docs.title: folioman import cas
docs.text:
Imports a CAMS, KFintech, or NSDL/CDSL eCAS PDF statement:

folioman import cas <FILE_PATH> --password <PASSWORD> [--investor-id <ID>]

Options:

  • --password, -p: Required password to unlock the encrypted statement PDF (usually the investor's PAN).
  • --investor-id: Optional ID of an existing investor to attach statements to. If omitted, matches or creates an investor using the PAN in the statement.

Example:

folioman import cas ~/Documents/CAMS_CAS.pdf -p "ABCDE1234F"

docs.title: folioman import csv
docs.text:
Imports custom or broker tradebook CSV files:

folioman import csv <FILE_PATH> --investor-id <ID>

docs.title: 3. folioman navs
docs.text: Manages market NAV and equity closing price feeds.

docs.title: folioman navs refresh
docs.text:
Fetches the latest closing quotes for all securities currently held in active portfolios:

folioman navs refresh [--types <mf,equity,crypto>]

Options:

  • --types: Comma-separated list of asset types to refresh (e.g. mf,equity). Defaults to all.

docs.title: folioman navs backfill
docs.text:
Scans held securities for historical price gaps between their earliest trade date and today, and backfills missing NAV history:

folioman navs backfill [--force]

Options:

  • --force: Re-pull the full historical price span regardless of existing data points.

docs.title: 4. folioman symbols
docs.text: Repairs holdings and resolves trading identifiers.

docs.title: folioman symbols resolve
docs.text:
Resolves missing NSE/BSE trading symbols for demat holdings (eCAS statements report holdings by ISIN only):

folioman symbols resolve [--backfill]

Options:

  • --backfill: Automatically trigger price-history backfill for newly resolved symbols.

docs.title: 5. folioman reconcile
docs.text: Runs balance reconciliation and integrity verification.

docs.title: folioman reconcile all
docs.text:
Re-reconciles trade ledger units against observed statement snapshots across all folios and investors:

folioman reconcile all

This verifies unit balances, calculates any drift, and updates the tax_safe status required for capital gains reporting.

docs.title: 6. folioman corporate-actions
docs.text: Fetches and caches corporate actions.

docs.title: folioman corporate-actions refresh
docs.text:
Queries NSE/BSE feeds for recent stock splits, bonus shares, mergers, and dividends:

folioman corporate-actions refresh

docs.title: 7. folioman valuations
docs.text: Manages portfolio net-worth series rollups.

docs.title: folioman valuations extend
docs.text:
Rolls all active investor portfolio valuations forward to today:

folioman valuations extend

docs.title: folioman valuations process-pending
docs.text:
Processes pending or failed valuation calculation tasks:

folioman valuations process-pending

docs.title: 8. folioman scheduler
docs.text: Runs an in-process background automation daemon.

docs.title: folioman scheduler run
docs.text:
Starts a blocking in-process scheduler (APScheduler) that automatically runs 6-hourly NAV refreshes, daily valuation rollups, and ISIN database update checks:

folioman scheduler run

docs.title: 9. folioman demo
docs.text: Demo and testing utilities.

docs.title: folioman demo seed
docs.text:
Seeds the database with realistic synthetic investors, mutual fund portfolios, equity transactions, and historical NAVs for testing and demonstration:

folioman demo seed

docs.title: Storage & Configuration
docs.text:
folioman-client is designed to be zero-setup by default, while supporting production databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) via standard SQLAlchemy connection strings.

Configuration is managed using Pydantic's pydantic-settings, reading from environment variables or a local .env file.

docs.title: The FoliomanSettings Class
docs.text:
The settings object is defined in folioman_client.config.FoliomanSettings. All settings use the FOLIOMAN_ environment variable prefix.

from folioman_client import FoliomanSettings

settings = FoliomanSettings()

docs.title: Settings Schema & Defaults
docs.text: Setting Attribute Environment Variable Type Default Value Description database_url FOLIOMAN_DATABASE_URL str "" SQLAlchemy connection URL. If empty, defaults to SQLite under data_dir. data_dir FOLIOMAN_DATA_DIR str "" Base directory for storage and logs. Defaults to OS user data dir (~/.folioman). fernet_key FOLIOMAN_FERNET_KEY str "" 32-byte url-safe base64 key for PAN encryption. Auto-generated if omitted. timeout FOLIOMAN_TIMEOUT float 30.0 HTTP timeout (seconds) for external price feeds (mfapi, Yahoo, AMFI). user_id FOLIOMAN_USER_ID str "default" Multi-tenancy tenant or advisor scope identifier.

If no connection string is provided, folioman-client automatically resolves a file path under the user data directory:

  • Linux: ~/.local/share/folioman/folioman.db
  • macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/folioman/folioman.db
  • Windows: %LOCALAPPDATA%\folioman\folioman.db

docs.title: SQLite Concurrency Guards
docs.text:
To prevent OperationalError: database is locked errors during concurrent operations, folioman-client automatically configures every SQLite connection with:

PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;
PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;
PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;

Transactions are executed in IMMEDIATE mode to prevent read-upgrade deadlocks.

docs.title: 2. PostgreSQL (Production & Team Use)
docs.text:
For multi-user applications, web backends, or containerized deployments (Docker / Kubernetes), connect to PostgreSQL using psycopg:

export FOLIOMAN_DATABASE_URL="postgresql+psycopg://username:password@localhost:5432/portfolio"

In Python:

from folioman_client import FoliomanClient

client = FoliomanClient(
    database_url="postgresql+psycopg://username:password@localhost:5432/portfolio"
)

Ensure psycopg is installed:

pip install "folioman-client[postgres]"

docs.title: 3. MySQL / MariaDB
docs.text: export FOLIOMAN_DATABASE_URL="mysql+aiomysql://username:password@localhost:3306/portfolio"

docs.title: Unified Database Model
docs.text:
In folioman-client v0.2.0, 100% of data lives inside your configured database:

  1. User Portfolios & Ledgers: Investors, folios, transactions, holdings, partial blocks, and daily net-worth points.
  2. Market & Daily Prices: Canonical securities, daily NAV history from AMFI / mfapi / Yahoo, and corporate action events.
  3. Reference Master: The 100,000-row national ISIN and mutual fund scheme reference dictionary (ref_schemes, ref_isins, ref_grandfathering_navs).

This architecture ensures:

  • Stateless Applications: You can spin up multiple containers or serverless workers pointing to a single RDS/PostgreSQL instance without needing shared persistent disk volumes.
  • Single Backup: A single pg_dump backup captures your entire portfolio and reference state.

docs.title: Schema Initialization & Versioning
docs.text:
folioman-client handles database creation and upgrades automatically.

When FoliomanClient() initializes or when running folioman isin seed:

  1. It executes Base.metadata.create_all() to ensure all 18 tables exist.
  2. It inspects the _schema_version table.
  3. If an older version is detected, it automatically executes non-destructive schema migrations.

docs.title: Sensitive Data & PAN Encryption
docs.text:
Under Indian data privacy guidelines, Permanent Account Numbers (PAN) must be protected.

  • Encryption at Rest: PANs are stored encrypted using symmetric Fernet encryption (cryptography).
  • Deterministic Lookup: An HMAC-SHA256 hash (pan_hash) is generated using the encryption key, allowing statements to match existing investors without decrypting all rows.
  • Key Resolution:
    1. FOLIOMAN_FERNET_KEY environment variable.
    2. Auto-generated file (~/.folioman/fernet.key) created with restricted owner permissions (0600).

docs.title: Development & Contributing
docs.text: This guide explains how to set up the development environment, execute tests, build documentation, and package folioman-client for distribution.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.11+
  • uv (recommended) or standard pip/venv

docs.title: Repository Setup
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository:

    git clone https://github.com/sid-146/folioman-client.git
cd folioman-client

  2. Install dependencies with uv: 

    uv sync
    This creates an isolated virtual environment in .venv/ and installs runtime, testing, and documentation packages.

docs.title: Running the Test Suite
docs.text:
The test suite uses pytest, pytest-asyncio, and respx for mock HTTP responses.

uv run pytest

To run with verbose output or targeted files:

uv run pytest -v tests/test_client.py

All 17 tests verify:

  • Proactive and reactive JWT token handling
  • Concurrency locks
  • Resource method parsing and status code mapping
  • Serialization and model validation

docs.title: Building the Package
docs.text:
We use hatchling as the build backend. Build both a binary wheel and source distribution (sdist):

uv build

Artifacts are placed into the dist/ directory:

  • dist/folioman_client-<version>-py3-none-any.whl
  • dist/folioman_client-<version>.tar.gz

docs.title: Documentation Workflow
docs.text: Documentation is built with MkDocs Material and mkdocstrings.

docs.title: Previewing Documentation Locally

Start a live reload server:

uv run mkdocs serve

Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/ in your browser. Changes saved in docs/ or Python docstrings will automatically refresh in your browser.

docs.text:
To verify all links, navigation entries, and Python docstrings resolve without warnings:

uv run mkdocs build --strict

docs.title: Code Quality & Docstring Conventions
docs.text:
When contributing new features or modifying existing public APIs:

  1. Strict Typing: All function signatures and model attributes must include complete type annotations.
  2. Google-Style Docstrings: Public classes, methods, models, and exceptions must feature Google-style docstrings (Args, Returns, Raises).
  3. No Credential Leaks: Never hardcode credentials, real JWTs, or production endpoints in tests, comments, or examples.

docs.title: CI/CD and Release Workflow
docs.text:
• CI Documentation Deployment (docs.yml): Pushes to main automatically run mkdocs gh-deploy to publish documentation to GitHub Pages at https://sid-146.github.io/folioman-client/.
  • PyPI Release (publish.yml): Publishing a GitHub Release triggers PyPI Trusted Publishing (OIDC) to build distributions and upload to PyPI automatically.

docs.title: Error Handling & Exceptions
docs.text: folioman-client provides a focused, predictable exception hierarchy derived from FoliomanError. This allows your application to handle missing entities, PDF password errors, parsing failures, and external price feed issues cleanly.

docs.title: Exception Hierarchy
docs.text:
graph TD
    Exception[Python Exception] --> FoliomanError[FoliomanError]
    FoliomanError --> FoliomanNotFoundError[FoliomanNotFoundError]
    FoliomanError --> FoliomanParseError[FoliomanParseError]
    FoliomanParseError --> FoliomanPasswordError[FoliomanPasswordError]
    FoliomanError --> FoliomanFeedError[FoliomanFeedError]
    FoliomanError --> FoliomanDatabaseError[FoliomanDatabaseError]

docs.title: FoliomanError
docs.text:
class FoliomanError(Exception):
    """Base exception for all Folioman client errors."""

The common ancestor of all SDK exceptions. Catching FoliomanError intercepts any library-specific error.

docs.title: FoliomanNotFoundError
docs.text:
class FoliomanNotFoundError(FoliomanError):
    """Raised when a requested resource (investor, security, transaction) does not exist."""
  • When Raised:
    • Requesting an investor_id that is not present in the database.
    • Querying a security_id not found in the catalog.
  • Recommended Action:
    • Catch and return a 404 or prompt the user to create the entity.

docs.title: FoliomanParseError
docs.text:
class FoliomanParseError(FoliomanError):
    """Raised when statement parsing fails or document shape is unsupported."""
  • When Raised:
    • The supplied file is not a valid CAMS/KFintech or NSDL/CDSL PDF statement.
    • The PDF structure is corrupted.

docs.title: FoliomanPasswordError
docs.text:
class FoliomanPasswordError(FoliomanParseError):
    """Raised when the PDF password is wrong or missing."""
  • When Raised:
    • Encrypted CAS PDF cannot be unlocked with the provided password.
  • Recommended Action:
    • Prompt the user to re-enter their statement password (usually the investor's PAN).

docs.title: FoliomanFeedError
docs.text:
class FoliomanFeedError(FoliomanError):
    """Raised when external price feed APIs fail or return malformed data."""
  • When Raised:
    • Network timeout or HTTP 5xx errors from mfapi.in, AMFI, Yahoo Finance, or CoinGecko.
  • Recommended Action:
    • Retain existing stale prices and retry the sync later.

docs.title: FoliomanDatabaseError
docs.text:
class FoliomanDatabaseError(FoliomanError):
    """Raised on database connection failures or integrity constraint violations."""
  • When Raised:
    • Database URL is unreachable or connection pool is exhausted.

docs.title: Practical Examples & Recipes
docs.text: This page provides practical, copy-pasteable recipes for common workflows using folioman-client.

docs.title: 1. Complete End-to-End Ingestion & Portfolio Valuation
docs.text:
This script initializes the local database, ingests a CAMS/KFintech CAS statement, updates market prices, and prints portfolio metrics:

import asyncio
from folioman_client import FoliomanClient


async def main() -> None:
    async with FoliomanClient() as client:
        # Step 1: Ingest statement PDF
        print("Parsing CAS statement...")
        job = await client.imports.cas_pdf(
            file_path="CAMS_CAS_Jan2026.pdf",
            password="ABCDE1234F",
        )
        print(f"Transactions created: {job.result.get('transactions_created')}")

        # Step 2: Fetch latest NAVs and prices
        print("Updating market prices...")
        await client.navs.refresh()

        # Step 3: Print portfolio valuation
        summary = await client.portfolio.get(investor_id=1)
        print(f"\n=== Portfolio Summary as of {summary.as_of} ===")
        print(f"Market Value: INR {summary.total_inr:,.2f}")
        print(f"Cost Basis:   INR {summary.invested_inr:,.2f}")
        print(f"Absolute P&L: INR {summary.unrealized_pnl_inr:,.2f} ({summary.return_pct:.2f}%)")
        if summary.xirr is not None:
            print(f"Annual XIRR:  {summary.xirr * 100:.2f}%")

        # Step 4: Asset allocation breakdown
        print("\n--- Asset Allocation ---")
        for mix in summary.asset_mix:
            print(f"{mix.security_type.title():<12}: INR {mix.value_inr:>12,.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: 2. Generating Schedule 112A Realized Capital Gains (Tax Filing)
docs.text:
Generate a detailed lot-level report for the Indian Income Tax Return (ITR):

import asyncio
from folioman_client import FoliomanClient


async def main() -> None:
    async with FoliomanClient() as client:
        # Generate capital gains report for Financial Year 2024-25 (Apr 2024 - Mar 2025)
        report = await client.capital_gains.get(investor_id=1, fy="2024-25")

        print(f"=== Capital Gains Report for FY {report.fy} ===")
        print(f"Total Disposals: {len(report.rows)}")
        print(f"Realized STCG:   INR {report.summary.stcg_inr:,.2f}")
        print(f"Realized LTCG:   INR {report.summary.ltcg_inr:,.2f}")
        print(f"Total Gain:      INR {report.summary.total_gain_inr:,.2f}")

        # Display Schedule 112A eligible lots
        print("\n--- Disposal Lot Details ---")
        for row in report.rows[:5]:
            print(
                f"{row.security_name[:25]:<26} | Sold: {row.date} | "
                f"Units: {row.units:>8.3f} | Gain: INR {row.gain_inr:>10,.2f} ({row.term})"
            )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: 4. Multi-Tenant Setup with PostgreSQL
docs.text:
In a wealth advisory or multi-tenant system, use user_id to enforce logical multi-tenancy:

import asyncio
from folioman_client import FoliomanClient

DATABASE_URL = "postgresql+psycopg://advisor:secret@localhost:5432/wealth_db"


async def main() -> None:
    # Client for Advisor A
    async with FoliomanClient(database_url=DATABASE_URL, user_id="advisor_alpha") as client_a:
        inv_a = await client_a.investors.create("Ramesh Sharma")
        print(f"Created Investor in Alpha: {inv_a.name} (ID: {inv_a.id})")

    # Client for Advisor B
    async with FoliomanClient(database_url=DATABASE_URL, user_id="advisor_beta") as client_b:
        inv_b = await client_b.investors.create("Priya Verma")
        print(f"Created Investor in Beta: {inv_b.name} (ID: {inv_b.id})")

        # Advisor B cannot see Advisor A's investors
        investors = await client_b.investors.list()
        print(f"Advisor B sees {len(investors)} investor(s).")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: 5. Automated Weekly NAV Sync with Embedded Scheduler
docs.text:
For persistent processes (e.g. desktop apps or long-running worker services), enable the embedded scheduler:

import asyncio
from folioman_client import FoliomanClient


async def main() -> None:
    # Launch with background scheduler enabled (runs daemon thread)
    async with FoliomanClient(start_scheduler=True) as client:
        print("Folioman engine running with 6-hourly background NAV sync...")
        # Keep process alive
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(3600)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

docs.text: This guide walks you through installing folioman-client, initializing the database, importing a Consolidated Account Statement (CAS), syncing market NAVs, and inspecting portfolio metrics and capital gains.

docs.title: 1. Installation
docs.text:
Install the package using your preferred package manager:

pipuvpoetry 
pip install folioman-client

uv add folioman-client

poetry add folioman-client

docs.text:
If you plan to use a PostgreSQL database instead of the default SQLite:

pip install "folioman-client[postgres]"

docs.title: 2. Quick CLI Tour
docs.text: folioman-client provides a terminal command folioman.

docs.title: Step A: Initialize and Seed Reference Data
docs.text:
On a fresh installation, seed the national ISIN reference dictionary:

folioman isin seed

This populates the ref_schemes, ref_isins, and ref_grandfathering_navs tables inside your database (defaulting to ~/.folioman/folioman.db).

docs.title: Step B: Ingest a CAS PDF
docs.text:
Download your Consolidated Account Statement PDF from CAMS, KFintech, or NSDL/CDSL, and import it:

folioman import cas ~/Downloads/CAS_Jan_2026.pdf --password "MYPAN1234F"

The CLI parses all schemes and transactions, normalizes folios, deduplicates historical rows, and establishes the investor profile.

docs.title: Step C: Fetch Latest Market NAVs
docs.text:
Sync latest daily NAVs and market closing quotes:

folioman navs refresh

To backfill historical NAV gaps back to the earliest transaction date:

folioman navs backfill

docs.title: Step D: Reconcile Balances
docs.text:
Verify your trade ledger against the reported statement closing units:

folioman reconcile all

docs.title: 3. Python SDK Quickstart
docs.text: You can perform the exact same workflows programmatically within your Python code.

docs.title: Minimal Script
docs.text:
import asyncio
from folioman_client import FoliomanClient


async def main() -> None:
    # 1. Connect (defaults to SQLite; or pass database_url="postgresql+psycopg://...")
    async with FoliomanClient() as client:
        # 2. Ingest statement
        print("Importing CAS statement...")
        job = await client.imports.cas_pdf(
            file_path="CAS_Jan_2026.pdf",
            password="ABCDE1234F",
        )
        print(f"Imported successfully! Created {job.result.get('transactions_created', 0)} transactions.")

        # 3. Refresh market NAVs
        print("Refreshing market NAVs...")
        await client.navs.refresh()

        # 4. List investors
        investors = await client.investors.list()
        for inv in investors:
            print(f"\nInvestor: {inv.name} (ID: {inv.id})")

            # 5. Fetch full portfolio summary
            summary = await client.portfolio.get(inv.id)
            print(f"  Total Portfolio Value: INR {summary.total_inr:,.2f}")
            print(f"  Total Cost Basis:     INR {summary.invested_inr:,.2f}")
            if summary.xirr is not None:
                print(f"  Annualized XIRR:      {summary.xirr * 100:.2f}%")

            # 6. Inspect priced holdings
            holdings = await client.holdings.list(inv.id)
            print(f"  Holdings count:       {len(holdings)}")
            for h in holdings[:5]:
                print(f"    - {h.name}: {h.units} units | INR {h.value_inr:,.2f}")

            # 7. Generate Realized Capital Gains Report (Schedule 112A)
            gains = await client.capital_gains.get(inv.id, fy="2024-25")
            print(f"  FY 2024-25 Realized LTCG: INR {gains.summary.ltcg_inr:,.2f}")
            print(f"  FY 2024-25 Realized STCG: INR {gains.summary.stcg_inr:,.2f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

docs.title: Data Models & Serialization Types
docs.text:
folioman-client models are built on Pydantic v2. They parse JSON responses into immutable, validated Python data structures.

All models inherit from FoliomanBaseModel, configured with extra="ignore" and populate_by_name=True. This ensures forward compatibility when the Folioman backend introduces new fields.

docs.title: Custom Serialization Types
docs.text:
In financial systems, floating-point rounding errors can corrupt monetary balances. folioman-client defines annotated Pydantic types in folioman_client.types to manage precision safely:

from folioman_client.types import (
    ConfiguredDecimal,
    ConfiguredDate,
    ConfiguredDatetime,
)
Type Alias Python Source Type JSON / Serialization Output Description ConfiguredDecimal decimal.Decimal float (unless None) Preserves decimal arithmetic precision in Python, but serializes to JSON numbers for downstream consumption. ConfiguredDate datetime.date str (ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DD) Formats dates to standard ISO strings on serialization (unless-none). ConfiguredDatetime datetime.datetime str (ISO-8601) Formats timestamp to standard ISO-8601 string on serialization (unless-none).

docs.title: Security & Privacy
docs.text: Financial applications handle sensitive Personal Identifiable Information (PII), including Indian Permanent Account Numbers (PAN). folioman-client implements defense-in-depth security to protect sensitive investor data at rest and enforce logical multi-tenancy.

docs.title: 1. PAN Encryption at Rest
docs.text:
In accordance with data protection best practices, PAN numbers are never stored in plaintext within the database.

  • Symmetric Encryption: PAN strings are encrypted using Fernet symmetric authenticated cryptography (cryptography.fernet.Fernet), backed by 128-bit AES in CBC mode with PKCS7 padding and HMAC-SHA256 authentication.
  • Binary Storage: Ciphertext is stored in the investors.pan_encrypted column as raw bytes (LargeBinary).
sequenceDiagram
    participant User as Caller / CAS PDF
    participant Engine as Security Layer
    participant DB as Selected Database

    User->>Engine: Plaintext PAN ("ABCDE1234F")
    Engine->>Engine: Normalize: uppercase + strip whitespace
    Engine->>Engine: Fernet.encrypt(normalized_pan)
    Engine->>Engine: hmac_sha256(fernet_key, normalized_pan)
    Engine->>DB: INSERT pan_encrypted (bytes), pan_hash (hex)

docs.title: 2. Keyed HMAC-SHA256 Lookup (pan_hash)
docs.text:
Because statements frequently need to match existing investor records during re-imports, decrypting every investor row in the database to find a matching PAN would be inefficient and insecure.

  • Why bare SHA-256 is insufficient: PANs follow a rigid 10-character alphanumeric syntax ([A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}) and have low entropy, making unkeyed hashes vulnerable to precomputed rainbow table attacks.

  • Keyed Hash (HMAC): folioman-client hashes the PAN using HMAC-SHA256, using the Fernet encryption key itself as the pepper secret:

    import hashlib
import hmac

def pan_hash(pan: str, key_bytes: bytes) -> str:
    return hmac.new(key_bytes, pan.strip().upper().encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

  • Security Guarantee: Without the encryption key, the pan_hash value is useless and cannot be reverse-engineered or dictionary-attacked.

docs.title: 3. Encryption Key Resolution
docs.text:
The Fernet key is resolved using the following order of precedence:

  1. FOLIOMAN_FERNET_KEY Environment Variable: Used in production, CI/CD, and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
  2. Key File (~/.folioman/fernet.key): In local development or desktop environments, if no environment variable is provided, folioman-client automatically generates a secure 32-byte URL-safe base64 key and writes it with restricted owner-only permissions (0600).

docs.title: 4. Masked Display (pan_masked)
docs.text:
To prevent accidental visual leaks or logging of full PAN values:

  • The single-investor detail model (InvestorDetail) returns only a masked PAN string: 
    XXXXXX1234F
  • The roster list (Investor) exposes only a boolean flag has_pan: bool, avoiding decryption overhead entirely when listing all investors.

docs.title: 5. Multi-Tenancy Scoping (user_id)
docs.text:
For platforms serving multiple advisors or tenant organizations:

  • All Family and Investor entities carry a user_id column.
  • Queries are strictly scoped to the active client's user_id: 
    async with FoliomanClient(user_id="advisor_alpha") as client:
